codex-component-ledger-review — EXACT-HASH D2 V5 VERDICT: APPROVE.

Independently verified plan SHA-256 e132aa3a74a19fe411068c4d45f2d9d9a6fc55e7b1a78d6a41bfbe197753f223 at 747 lines and notes SHA-256 4949b0852e1d09fbeaf6f673e05bc51e98bcfab9373fd06a6798ffcf44d89677 at 5447 lines against main 0b414b443e62cf4ee67a7f81e4846c2a8c13ab36. The two-path diff is 208 insertions and 21 deletions; git diff --check is clean; I inspected the complete diff.

The V4 blocks are closed in bytes. Plan 142-168 now binds mapping family, directed source/target roles, exact geometry, occurrences, explicit epoch/discontinuity seams, and endpoints into the canonical relation contract; coalescing cannot cross family, direction, occurrence, gap, hold, epoch, or discontinuity boundaries. Courts 586-596 separately exercise split/coalesce equivalence, family/direction substitution, same-coefficient seam deletion, conditional round trips, all occurrence-scoped preimages, no first-match reverse, and gap-preserving composition. Edition playback PTS no longer occurs; plan 100-103, 119-120, 165-168, and D2 register 727 consistently use the audience-facing edition playback axis.

The rest of the scout contract remains coherent: present/missing PTS and DTS cannot be conflated with AV_NOPTS_VALUE; packet-duration zero is unknown; signed origins, wraps, resets, and epochs survive; exact rational projection, typed quantization/enclosure, rounding/residual policy, overflow-safe refusal, tolerance not equality, and reverse/preimage laws are explicit. Arithmetic or quantization refusal remains a distinct total outcome in plan 173-185, structural gate 528-531, court 577-582, and notes 5370-5378.

History and authority are sound. Current notes lines 1-5338 hash exactly like main, section 120.6 retains the historical weightless PySceneDetect wording at 5261, and appended section 121 records both the time-contract evolution and ContentDetector terminology correction at 5444-5447. Plan 3-7 and 739-747 keep this an open, documentation-only pre-C1 contract with no package, media, provider, runtime, API, or acquisition authority.

Interpretive guard for implementation: because plan 145-157 makes an explicit seam part of canonical relation identity, the seam-deletion court at 591-593 cannot be satisfied by changing unrelated support metadata while leaving canonical relation identity unchanged. Under that binding law, I find no remaining blocker or required amendment. No file edit or runtime action was performed.
